chunks: (3) Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Sa'id narrated from Ali ibn al-Hasan at-Taymali, who said: al-Hasan and Muhammad, the sons of Ali ibn Yousuf, narrated from Sa'dan ibn Muslim from Sabah al-Muzni from al-Harith ibn Haseera from Habba al-Orani, who said: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said:
As if I see our Shia in the mosque of Kufa, who have set up pavilions teaching the people the Qur'an as it was revealed. Indeed, when our Qa'im arises, he will destroy it and level its mihrab.
ai.seo_question: What will the Qa'im do to the mosques and pavilions of the Shia when he appears?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Nu'mani’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* highlights the transitional phase of the Shia community, where they engage in popular Qur'anic education in Kufa before the rise of the Qa'im. The Imam’s prediction that the Qa'im will 'break' the pavilions and 'level' the mihrab signifies a shift from decentralized, perhaps fragmented, scholarly efforts to a unified, authoritative religious structure under the Imam’s direct guidance, restoring the true essence of worship and leadership.
